preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of different types of ingredients N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**4 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each ingredient quantity A_i must be between 1 and 10,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of picks required or -1 if it is impossible to get two units of each type.
